enable_amd64_microcode.description: Enable loading of AMD CPU microcode updates at boot.

enable_intel_microcode.description: Enable loading of Intel CPU microcode updates at boot.

anacron_enabled.description: Enable Anacron to run scheduled jobs (e.g., daily/weekly) on systems that may be off.

bluez_hciattach_enabled.description: Enable automatic attachment of Bluetooth HCI devices.

chrony_daemon_options.description: Extra command-line options passed to chronyd/chrony-wait at startup (e.g., '-u chrony').

cron_enabled.description: Enable the cron daemon to run scheduled tasks.

dbus_session_bus_address.description: Custom D-Bus session bus address (e.g., 'unix:path=/run/user/1000/bus'). Leave empty for default.

freeipa_client_enabled.description: Enable SUDO support from FreeIPA client for centralized policy.

im_config_session_enabled.description: Enable im-config to manage input method settings per user session.

kerneloops_enabled.description: Enable kernel oops/panic reporting to kerneloops.org.

networkd_dispatcher_enabled.description: Enable networkd-dispatcher to run network-state hooks.

numlock_enabled.description: Turn Num Lock on automatically on system boot/login.

sshd_options.description: Extra command-line options for sshd (e.g., '-D' to run in foreground).

openvpn_enabled.description: Automatically start OpenVPN tunnels on boot (by name: /etc/openvpn/*.conf).

passwd_quality_enabled.description: Enforce strong password policies via PAM (e.g., pam_pwquality).

rsync_daemon_enabled.description: Enable the rsync daemon for file sharing (insecure unless properly firewall-protected).

sane_daemon_enabled.description: Start the sane-daemon for remote scanner access.

smartd_enabled.description: Enable smartmontools' smartd to monitor SMART health of disks.

sssd_enabled.description: Enable SSSD for centralized authentication (e.g., LDAP/AD).

ufw_enabled.description: Enable the Uncomplicated Firewall (ufw) at boot.

xrdp_enabled.description: Enable the xrdp remote desktop server.
